inputs.prompt: <Video 1> <Picture 1> <Picture 2> A tender early-morning scene in a modest 1990s Chinese working-class home bedroom, soft golden sunlight filtering through white lace curtains, the curtains swaying very slightly, dust motes drifting in the light beam. Throughout the entire shot, the action is one continuous gentle motion: a young Chinese mother in her late twenties with two neat low braids, wearing a clean indigo-blue cotton jacket, stands behind the little girl and combs her hair. The comb starts at the top of the girl's head and slowly strokes down and back through her black hair in one smooth unhurried motion, then returns to the top and strokes down again, repeating this slow steady combing rhythm continuously; her hands move only around the girl's head, her body stays leaning gently forward in the same position. The little girl, around six years old with a black bob haircut and neat bangs, wearing a clean pale-yellow cotton jacket and grey-blue trousers, sits on a small wooden stool in front of a wooden dresser with a wall mirror the whole time; she stays seated without moving, hands resting quietly on her lap, head tilting slightly up, eyes calm and gentle. The mother remains standing from beginning to end — she does not sit down, does not stand up, does not walk; the girl remains seated from beginning to end. No posture change, no cut, no sudden movement. Both characters have clear detailed faces exactly matching the reference portraits <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>. The room has pale green painted walls, a neatly made bed with folded quilts, a wooden nightstand with an alarm clock, clean worn wooden floor. Refined watercolor concept-art animation style, delicate fine ink linework, loose transparent watercolor washes, granular cold-press paper texture, restrained indigo black denim-grey and cream palette, warm luminous morning sunlight, quiet intimate nostalgic atmosphere, slow continuous camera push-in, gentle seamless motion.
